Sam Ortiz: Candidate Elena cannot take daytime interviews due to school dropoff. Shes available 5:20pm-6:10pm PT next Thu. Can we do a single 40m loop starting 5:30pm?

Maya Lin: I can move my schedule. 5:30-6:10 works. I can take first 25m.

Devon Reed: Works for me; prefer remote. Ill handle coding deep-dive 5:55-6:05 and wrap.

PeopleOps Bot: Care stipend policy: up to $100 for interview-related childcare when pre-approved. Submit receipts to Expensify with code "CARE-INTERVIEW". Approval must be logged before reimbursement.

Sam Ortiz: Pre-approving $80 for Elena (noted in candidate record). Reserving Quiet Room G2 as backup if she comes onsite last-minute.

Candidate - Elena: Thanks! 5:30pm PT is perfect. Ill join remote and appreciate the stipend offer.

Maya Lin: Please add Zoom + backup Meet and a 2-line prep note in the invite. No recordings.

Sam Ortiz: Invite sent with links and prep note. DMing Elena expense instructions and tagging people-ops receipts. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
